scope: Model-free acquisition and identity registration of post-2016 original assay papers; no workflow or evolutionary extraction.
outcome: Source job stopped at the required-ten-input preflight. Seven methods were staged, while multiple additional registered primary papers were present but staging failed on an existing supplement directory.
root_cause: Raw supplement registrations and copied model-input files both used methods/<method>/supplement_1. stage_source.mkdir() raised FileExistsError after successful primary registration; this was a staging defect, not missing primary evidence.
repair: Keep raw registration folders unchanged; stage normalized inputs under methods/<method>/inputs/<label>. assemble_downloaded.py reads completed receipts, verifies original/text hashes and exact assigned identities, then writes a fresh ten-paper manifest with no network or model calls.
target_scope_correction: scNMT-seq is present in the existing Illumina poster inventory. The new candidate pool excludes it and substitutes already-acquired Paired-Tag. catalogue_absence_audit.json records all name/alias and reference-PMID checks against the actual273-method inventory.

cancelled_content_job.status: Parent reports cancellation while pending, before content model calls. Original submission artifacts are retained.
cancelled_content_job.reason: Freeze corrected target selection and catalogue-absence gate before native content execution.

assembly_status: Prepared and tested; actual assembly is to run as the first stage of the replacement content Slurm allocation.
no_target_illumina_diagrams: No matching method ID/name/verified alias or assigned primary PMID was found for the selected ten in the pinned273-method inventory. This is scoped inventory absence, not a worldwide claim about Illumina resources.
